verdict: Leads surged this period — now the focus shifts to converting them.
narrative: You received 70 leads over the last 28 days at $25.80 per lead, with the sharpest acceleration coming in the final week — a 780% jump in leads versus the prior 7-day period and a 46% drop in cost per lead, confirming the campaign is finding its stride. The concern right now is that your CRM shows 59 contacts against those 70 leads, and none have moved into an active pipeline opportunity, meaning the intake process is not yet capturing or advancing every inquiry. SMS automation and phone access are being resolved this week to close that gap and improve the speed-to-contact on new leads. Once intake is running cleanly, the volume and efficiency numbers you're seeing make a strong case for scaling spend.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days, all from Meta advertising
cost per lead this period, down 46% from the prior 7-day stretch
organic actions from your Google Business Profile this period — calls, website clicks, and more

watch_item.issue: 11 leads are unaccounted for between the ad platform and your CRM, and no leads have progressed to an active opportunity yet.
watch_item.fix: SMS automation and phone system access are being brought online now, and CRM intake is being audited to ensure every lead is logged and followed up automatically going forward.
